passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.1
passages.text: Tityre, tu patulae recubans sub tegmine fagi

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.2
passages.text: silvestrem tenui Musam meditaris avena;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.3
passages.text: nos patriae fines et dulcia linquimus arva:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.4
passages.text: nos patriam fugimus; tu, Tityre, lentus in umbra

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.5
passages.text: formosam resonare doces Amaryllida silvas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.6
passages.text: O Meliboee, deus nobis haec otia fecit:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.7
passages.text: namque erit ille mihi semper deus; illius aram

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.8
passages.text: saepe tener nostris ab ovilibus imbuet agnus.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.9
passages.text: Ille meas errare boves, ut cernis, et ipsum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.10
passages.text: ludere, quae vellem, calamo permisit agresti

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.11
passages.text: Non equidem invideo; miror magis: undique totis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.12
passages.text: usque adeo turbatur agris. En, ipse capellas

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.13
passages.text: protinus aeger ago; hanc etiam vix, Tityre, duco:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.14
passages.text: hic inter densas corylos modo namque gemellos,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.15
passages.text: spem gregis, ah, silice in nuda conixa reliquit.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.16
passages.text: Saepe malum hoc nobis, si mens non laeva fuisset,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.17
passages.text: de caelo tactas memini praedicere quercus:—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.19
passages.text: Sed tamen, iste deus qui sit, da, Tityre, nobis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.20
passages.text: Urbem, quam dicunt Romam, Meliboee, putavi

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.21
passages.text: stultus ego huic nostrae similem, quo saepe solemus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.22
passages.text: pastores ovium teneros depellere fetus:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.23
passages.text: sic canibus catulos similis, sic matribus haedos

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.24
passages.text: noram, sic parvis componere magna solebam:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.25
passages.text: verum haec tantum alias inter caput extulit urbes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.26
passages.text: quantum lenta solent inter viburna cupressi.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.27
passages.text: Et quae tanta fuit Romam tibi causa videndi?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.28
passages.text: Libertas; quae sera, tamen respexit inertem,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.29
passages.text: candidior postquam tondenti barba cadebat;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.30
passages.text: respexit tamen, et longo post tempore venit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.31
passages.text: postquam nos Amaryllis habet, Galatea reliquit:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.32
passages.text: namque, fatebor enim, dum me Galatea tenebat,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.33
passages.text: nec spes libertatis erat, nec cura peculi:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.34
passages.text: quamvis multa meis exiret victima saeptis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.35
passages.text: pinguis et ingratae premeretur caseus urbi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.36
passages.text: non umquam gravis aere domum mihi dextra redibat.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.37
passages.text: Mirabar, quid maesta deos, Amarylli, vocares,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.38
passages.text: cui pendere sua patereris in arbore poma:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.39
passages.text: Tityrus hinc aberat. Ipsae te, Tityre, pinus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.40
passages.text: ipsi te fontes, ipsa haec arbusta vocabant.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.41
passages.text: Quid facerem? Neque servitio me exire licebat,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.42
passages.text: nec tam praesentis alibi cognoscere divos.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.43
passages.text: hic illum vidi iuvenem, Meliboee, quot annis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.44
passages.text: bis senos cui nostra dies altaria fumant;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.45
passages.text: hic mihi responsum primus dedit ille petenti:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.46
passages.text: “pascite, ut ante, boves, pueri, submittite tauros.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.47
passages.text: Fortunate senex, ergo tua rura manebunt,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.48
passages.text: et tibi magna satis, quamvis lapis omnia nudus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.49
passages.text: limosoque palus obducat pascua iunco!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.50
passages.text: Non insueta gravis temptabunt pabula fetas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.51
passages.text: nec mala vicini pecoris contagia laedent.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.52
passages.text: Fortunate senex, hic, inter flumina nota

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.53
passages.text: et fontis sacros, frigus captabis opacum!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.54
passages.text: hinc tibi, quae semper, vicino ab limite, saepes

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.55
passages.text: Hyblaeis apibus florem depasta salicti

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.56
passages.text: saepe levi somnum suadebit inire susurro;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.57
passages.text: hinc alta sub rupe canet frondator ad auras;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.58
passages.text: nec tamen interea raucae, tua cura, palumbes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.59
passages.text: nec gemere aëria cessabit turtur ab ulmo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.60
passages.text: Ante leves ergo pascentur in aequore cervi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.61
passages.text: et freta destituent nudos in litore pisces,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.62
passages.text: ante pererratis amborum finibus exsul

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.63
passages.text: aut Ararim Parthus bibet, aut Germania Tigrim,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.64
passages.text: quam nostro illius labatur pectore voltus.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.65
passages.text: At nos hinc alii sitientis ibimus Afros,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.66
passages.text: pars Scythiam et rapidum Cretae veniemus Oaxen,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.67
passages.text: et penitus toto divisos orbe Britannos.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.68
passages.text: En umquam patrios longo post tempore finis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.69
passages.text: pauperis et tuguri congestum caespite culmen,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.70
passages.text: post aliquot mea regna videns mirabor aristas?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.71
passages.text: Impius haec tam culta novalia miles habebit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.72
passages.text: barbarus has segetes? En, quo discordia civis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.73
passages.text: produxit miseros! His nos consevimus agros!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.74
passages.text: Insere nunc, Meliboee, piros, pone ordine vitis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.75
passages.text: Ite meae, felix quondam pecus, ite capellae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.76
passages.text: Non ego vos posthac, viridi proiectus in antro,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.77
passages.text: dumosa pendere procul de rupe videbo;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.78
passages.text: carmina nulla canam; non, me pascente, capellae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.79
passages.text: florentem cytisum et salices carpetis amaras.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.80
passages.text: Hic tamen hanc mecum poteras requiescere noctem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.81
passages.text: fronde super viridi: sunt nobis mitia poma,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.82
passages.text: castaneae molles, et pressi copia lactis;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.83
passages.text: et iam summa procul villarum culmina fumant,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 1.84
passages.text: maioresque cadunt altis de montibus umbrae.
